visual.general_description: Three color clinical photographs labelled A, B and C showing skin findings: a red scaly plaque in a skin fold below a breast, scattered small spots on an arm with a black box over part of the image, and a reddish-purple area behind an ear.
visual.detailed_description: Panels A to C sit side by side with white lettered boxes at lower right. Close-up of skin in the fold below a partly visible breast, with a hand in the upper left lifting the breast (red nail polish visible). A bright red to purplish plaque with an irregular outline lies in the fold, with white flaky scale and pale residue along part of its lower edge and smaller faint red areas around it. A white box with the printed letter A is at the lower right. Photograph of a bare arm with scattered small pale-brown to reddish flat spots and papules, and a few small faint marks. At the right a black rectangle covers part of the image beside a hand and the edge of white underwear. A white box with the printed letter B is at the lower right. Close-up of an ear with surrounding hair at the right and top, and a faint reddish-purple scaly area on the skin just behind and below the ear lobe. Only the ear and adjacent skin are visible. A white box with the printed letter C is partly cut off at the lower right.

A panel letter in serif type is at the lower right and small bold printed glyphs sit under the lower left of the body; they are too small to read.

visual.general_description: Five small blue fused axial PET-CT cross sections labelled A to E in a row, each with orange-yellow focal signal.
visual.detailed_description: A single wide strip of five axial fused images at jaw, neck, upper chest, upper abdomen and pelvic levels, separated by thin gray lines, with white panel letters at lower right of each. Small axial slice at the jaw: the mandible outline curves at the top, with several orange-yellow to white foci on both sides of the neck behind the jaw and a pair of bright white foci near the airway. Letter A at lower right. Axial slice through the lower neck with the airway at the top center, spine below, and several small orange-yellow foci at both sides of the neck, with two larger ones on the left of the image. Letter B at lower right. Axial slice at the upper chest with dark lung fields on both sides, both upper arms at the edges, and small orange-yellow foci in the central mediastinum, near the great vessels and in both axillary regions. Letter C at lower right. Axial slice of the upper abdomen showing a large organ on the left of the image with a mottled purple-gray appearance and, on the right of the image, curved orange-brown signal along the spleen and adjacent structures, with the spine at the lower center and both arms at the edges. Letter D at lower right. Axial slice at the pelvis showing the femoral heads and pubic bones as bright rings, with a few small orange-yellow foci in both groin regions and the gas-filled rectum at the lower center. Letter E at lower right.
